## v0.8.8 — Guitar Tuner and Metro

**Tuner** listens on the built-in mic and maps pitch to the nearest open Standard guitar string (EADGBE, A4=440), with a cents needle and IN TUNE within ±5¢.

**Metro** is a Yamaha ME-110–style metronome: horizontal beat LEDs next to a large BPM readout, Tempo 30–250, Beat 0–7, Vol 0–10, speaker clicks, and NVS memory for the last settings.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.8** (Companion versionCode 10). Companion behavior is unchanged.
